senses.en: food made from flour and water, shaped and usually boiled

ex.en: We cooked pasta with fresh tomatoes and mushrooms.
ex.zh: 我们用新鲜番茄和蘑菇做了意大利面。

ex.en: School canteens can serve wholegrain pasta with vegetables to provide affordable meals with more fibre.
ex.zh: 学校食堂可以供应搭配蔬菜的全麦意大利面，提供价格实惠、膳食纤维更多的餐食。

tip: 不可数；一份意面可说a bowl of pasta。

senses.en: To give money for something or for someone's work
Money received regularly for doing a job
To bring a benefit or be worth doing

ex.en: Can I pay for these apples by card?
ex.zh: 这些苹果可以刷卡付款吗？

ex.en: Employers should pay workers fairly to improve staff morale and reduce the number of people leaving.
ex.zh: 雇主应公平支付员工薪酬，以提高士气并减少人员流失。

tip: pay for接所购物品；pay接账单或款额；过去式paid。

senses.en: A tool that uses ink to write or draw.
A small enclosed area where animals are kept.
To write a letter, story or other piece of writing.

ex.en: Could you lend me a pen for this form?
ex.zh: 你能借我一支笔填这张表吗？

ex.en: Some students prefer using a pen because writing by hand helps them organise their ideas.
ex.zh: 有些学生更喜欢用笔，因为手写有助于他们整理思路。

tip: pen泛指墨水笔；钢笔可明确说fountain pen。

senses.en: A tool with a solid core for writing or drawing.
To write or draw something with a pencil.

ex.en: She sharpened her pencil before sketching the sleeping cat.
ex.zh: 她削好铅笔，开始画那只熟睡的猫。

ex.en: Using a pencil allows students to revise diagrams easily as their understanding of scientific concepts develops.
ex.zh: 使用铅笔让学生能随着对科学概念理解的加深，轻松修改图示。

tip: 用铅笔写说in pencil；pencil in指暂定安排。

senses.en: Human beings considered together or referred to in general.
A group sharing a culture, history, or national identity.

ex.en: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，有几个人在面包店外等候。

ex.en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that people of all ages can travel independently.
ex.zh: 城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让各年龄段的人都能独立出行。

col: people from all walks of life｜各行各业的人
tip: 表示人们时用people；peoples指多个民族。

senses.en: an individual human being
a grammatical category distinguishing speakers, listeners, and others

ex.en: Only one person was waiting outside the bakery.
ex.zh: 只有一个人在面包店外等候。

ex.en: Every person should have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of income or employment status.
ex.zh: 每个人都应享有负担得起的医疗服务，无论其收入或就业状况如何。

tip: 普通复数用people；persons多见于正式法律语境。

senses.en: Belonging or relating to one particular person.
Concerning someone's private life rather than public matters.

senses.zh: 针对个人的；人身攻击的
senses.en: Directed at someone's character rather than their ideas or actions.

ex.en: Please keep your personal belongings close while boarding the train.
ex.zh: 上火车时，请将个人物品放在身边。

ex.en: Online services should protect personal information and explain clearly how they collect and use customer data.
ex.zh: 在线服务应保护个人信息，并清楚说明如何收集和使用客户数据。

tip: personal指个人的；personnel指全体员工，注意拼写。

senses.en: An animal kept at home for company and pleasure.
To gently touch an animal with your hand.

ex.en: Our pet rabbit loves hiding under the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我们的宠物兔喜欢躲在厨房桌子下面。

ex.en: Caring for a pet can help children develop responsibility and learn to recognise the needs of others.
ex.zh: 照顾宠物能帮助儿童培养责任感，并学会察觉他人的需求。

tip: 动词过去式为petted；英式英语中抚摸也常用stroke。

senses.en: a device used to speak to people at a distance
to contact someone using a telephone

ex.en: My phone rang while I was washing the dishes.
ex.zh: 我洗碗时，电话响了。

ex.en: Limiting phone use in classrooms may help students concentrate more effectively on lessons and group activities.
ex.zh: 限制课堂上的手机使用，可能有助于学生更专注于课程和小组活动。

col: phone someone back｜给某人回电话
tip: 动词直接接人：phone someone，不加to。

senses.en: A picture made using a camera.

ex.en: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们在那座老桥旁拍了张照片。

ex.en: Historical photos provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
ex.zh: 历史照片为研究城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵证据。

tip: photo是photograph的常用简称；复数为photos。

senses.en: a picture made using a camera
to take a picture of someone or something using a camera

ex.en: This photograph shows my grandparents standing beside their first house.
ex.zh: 这张照片里，我的祖父母站在他们的第一所房子旁。

ex.en: Historical photographs provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
ex.zh: 历史照片为城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵的证据。

tip: 拍照用take a photograph，不用make。

senses.en: A large musical instrument played by pressing black and white keys.

ex.en: My sister practises the piano after dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后练钢琴。

ex.en: Learning to play the piano can help children develop concentration and express their emotions creatively.
ex.zh: 学习弹钢琴能帮助儿童培养专注力，并创造性地表达情感。

tip: 表示弹钢琴通常说play the piano。

senses.en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually with food brought from home
to eat a meal outdoors for pleasure

ex.en: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
ex.zh: 我们在一棵树的荫凉下野餐。

ex.en: Public parks provide affordable spaces where families can enjoy picnics and spend quality time together.
ex.zh: 公共公园提供了花费不高的空间，让家庭享受野餐并共度美好时光。

tip: 动词过去式为picnicked，进行形式为picnicking。

senses.en: an image made by drawing, painting, or taking a photograph
an idea or description of what a situation is like
to form an image of someone or something in your mind

ex.en: She hung a picture of the sea above her bed.
ex.zh: 她在床头上方挂了一幅海景画。

ex.en: Survey results provide a clearer picture of how housing costs affect the wellbeing of young adults.
ex.zh: 调查结果更清楚地呈现了住房成本如何影响年轻成年人的幸福感。

col: picture yourself doing something｜想象自己做某事
tip: take a picture是拍照；draw a picture是画画。

senses.en: a part of something or a single item
a work of writing, music, or art
to join separate parts to make something complete

ex.en: She saved the last piece of cake for her brother.
ex.zh: 她把最后一块蛋糕留给了弟弟。

ex.en: Each piece of evidence should be carefully assessed before researchers draw conclusions about environmental change.
ex.zh: 研究人员在对环境变化作出结论前，应仔细评估每一项证据。

col: a piece of advice｜一条建议
a piece of equipment｜一件设备
a piece of music｜一首乐曲
tip: a piece of可量化advice等不可数名词。

senses.en: A farm animal with a broad snout and short legs.

ex.en: A pink pig was sleeping beside the wooden fence.
ex.zh: 一头粉色的猪正睡在木栅栏旁。

ex.en: Farmers can improve animal welfare by giving pigs enough space to move freely and explore.
ex.zh: 农民可以给猪足够的自由活动和探索空间，以改善动物福利。

tip: pig指动物；作为食物的猪肉通常用pork。

senses.en: having a pale red colour
a colour made by mixing red with white

ex.en: The tree outside our window has pink flowers.
ex.zh: 我们窗外的树开着粉红色的花。

ex.en: Designers often use soft colours such as pink to create a welcoming atmosphere in children's healthcare facilities.
ex.zh: 设计师常用粉红色等柔和色彩，为儿童医疗机构营造温馨的氛围。

tip: pink既可作形容词，也可作名词表示粉红色。

senses.en: Flat bread baked with toppings such as tomato sauce and cheese.

ex.en: We shared a mushroom pizza after the film.
ex.zh: 电影结束后，我们分着吃了一张蘑菇比萨。

ex.en: Although pizza is convenient, its nutritional value depends largely on the ingredients and portion size.
ex.zh: 虽然比萨方便食用，但其营养价值主要取决于食材和食用份量。

col: a slice of pizza｜一片比萨
tip: 整张可数：a pizza；泛指食物可说some pizza。

senses.en: A particular area, position, or location.
To put something in a particular position.
A space available for someone to sit, study, or participate.

ex.en: This shady spot is a lovely place for a picnic.
ex.zh: 这处阴凉的地方很适合野餐。

ex.en: Urban planners should place public facilities near residential areas to make essential services accessible to everyone.
ex.zh: 城市规划者应将公共设施设在住宅区附近，让所有人都能方便地获得基本服务。

col: a university place｜大学录取名额
tip: take place表示发生或举行，不用被动语态。

senses.en: An arrangement or idea for what to do in future.
To decide what to do and how to do it.
A drawing showing the layout of a building or area.

ex.en: Our plan is to leave early and avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 我们的计划是早点出发，避开拥堵。

ex.en: Cities need a clear plan for expanding public transport before introducing restrictions on private vehicles.
ex.zh: 城市在实施私家车限制措施之前，需要制定明确的公共交通扩展计划。

col: plan to do something｜计划做某事
tip: plan to do表示打算做；过去式planned双写n。

senses.en: a flying vehicle with wings and at least one engine
a flat surface extending in every direction
to make wood smooth using a special cutting tool

ex.en: Our plane landed just before the rain began.
ex.zh: 我们的飞机刚降落，雨就下起来了。

ex.en: Travelling by plane saves time, but its environmental impact should be considered when planning transport policy.
ex.zh: 乘飞机出行节省时间，但制定交通政策时应考虑其环境影响。

tip: by plane不加冠词；on a plane需加冠词。

senses.en: a living thing that usually grows in soil and has leaves
to put seeds or young plants into soil to grow
a factory or facility where industrial processes take place

ex.en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
ex.zh: 这株小植物需要更多阳光和更少的水。

ex.en: Local authorities should plant more trees to improve air quality and provide shade in crowded neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 地方政府应多种树，以改善空气质量，并为人口密集的社区提供绿荫。

tip: plant可指植物或工厂；作动词时常表示种植。

senses.en: A flat, usually round dish used for serving food.
A flat piece of metal or another hard material.
To cover an object with a thin layer of metal.

ex.en: She placed a warm pancake on my plate.
ex.zh: 她在我的盘子里放了一张热乎乎的薄煎饼。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce food waste by offering smaller plates and allowing customers to request extra portions.
ex.zh: 餐馆可以提供较小的餐盘，并允许顾客要求加量，从而减少食物浪费。

col: a plate of rice｜一盘米饭
tip: plate通常指浅盘，bowl指较深的碗。

senses.en: Enjoy an activity or take part in a game
Perform music or a role, or make a recording run
A story written for actors to perform

ex.en: The children played with wooden blocks on the floor.
ex.zh: 孩子们在地板上玩木制积木。

ex.en: Schools should provide safe outdoor spaces where children can play and develop essential social skills.
ex.zh: 学校应提供安全的户外空间，让孩子们玩耍并培养重要的社交技能。

col: play a role in｜在…中发挥作用
put on a play｜上演一部戏剧
tip: 球类前通常不加冠词；乐器前通常用the。

senses.en: someone who takes part in a sport or game
someone who plays a musical instrument
a device or program that plays recorded sound or video

ex.en: Each player shook hands before the football match began.
ex.zh: 足球比赛开始前，每位球员都握了手。

ex.en: Young players benefit from coaches who value teamwork and personal development rather than winning alone.
ex.zh: 教练若重视团队合作和个人成长，而非一味追求胜利，年轻运动员就能从中受益。

col: team player｜善于团队合作的人
tip: 乐器演奏者可用“乐器名＋player”，如piano player。

senses.en: Used to make a request or offer more polite.
To make someone feel happy or satisfied.

ex.en: Could you please hold the door for me?
ex.zh: 你能帮我扶一下门吗？

ex.en: Public policies designed to please every group may fail to address the most urgent social problems.
ex.zh: 旨在取悦所有群体的公共政策，可能无法解决最紧迫的社会问题。

tip: please是动词；感到满意用be pleased。

senses.en: The official organisation responsible for preventing crime and maintaining order.
To maintain order somewhere or ensure rules are obeyed.

ex.en: The police helped us find our missing bicycle.
ex.zh: 警方帮我们找到了丢失的自行车。

ex.en: Effective cooperation between police and local residents can improve public safety and build trust within communities.
ex.zh: 警方与当地居民的有效合作可以改善公共安全，并建立社区内部的信任。

col: police an event｜维持活动秩序
tip: the police作主语用复数；一名警察用a police officer。

senses.en: a male police officer

ex.en: A policeman helped us cross the busy road.
ex.zh: 一位男警察帮我们穿过了繁忙的马路。

ex.en: A local policeman visited the school to explain how children can stay safe online.
ex.zh: 当地一位男警察到学校讲解儿童如何保障上网安全。

tip: policeman指男性；不强调性别用police officer。

senses.en: An artificial swimming basin or a small area of still water
A supply of money, people, or resources available for shared use
To combine resources so people can use them together

ex.en: We spent the afternoon swimming in the outdoor pool.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在室外游泳池游泳。

ex.en: Small businesses can pool their resources to purchase equipment that would otherwise be too expensive.
ex.zh: 小企业可以集中资源，购买单独承担会过于昂贵的设备。

col: a pool of talent｜人才储备
tip: pool resources指集中资源；play pool则指打美式台球。

senses.en: Having very little money or few possessions
Of low quality or lacking something necessary
Deserving sympathy because of an unfortunate situation

ex.en: The poor family could barely afford fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 这户贫困家庭几乎买不起新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Poor public transport can limit employment opportunities for people living far from major urban centres.
ex.zh: 公共交通不便可能限制远离主要城市中心的居民的就业机会。

tip: poor at表示不擅长；poor in表示缺乏。

senses.en: A country in southwestern Europe, west of Spain.

ex.en: We travelled along the coast of Portugal by train.
ex.zh: 我们乘火车沿葡萄牙海岸旅行。

ex.en: Tourism contributes to the economy of Portugal, but coastal development requires careful planning to protect natural habitats.
ex.zh: 旅游业为葡萄牙经济作出贡献，但沿海开发需要周密规划，以保护自然栖息地。

col: the coast of Portugal｜葡萄牙海岸
tip: 国名前通常不加the；Portuguese指葡语或葡萄牙的。

senses.en: able to happen, exist, or be done
worth considering as a choice or explanation

ex.en: Is it possible to book a table for tonight?
ex.zh: 可以预订今晚的餐桌吗？

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy makes it possible for countries to reduce their dependence on imported fuels.
ex.zh: 对可再生能源的投资使各国有可能减少对进口燃料的依赖。

col: make it possible｜使之成为可能
tip: 常用it is possible to do；不说人is possible to do。

senses.en: a place where people send mail and buy stamps

ex.en: I took the parcel to the post office before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前，我把包裹送到了邮局。

ex.en: A local post office can provide essential services for rural residents who lack reliable internet access.
ex.zh: 当地邮局可以为缺乏可靠网络连接的农村居民提供基本服务。

tip: 标准拼写为post office，两词之间不加连字符。
note: 已将非标准连字符拼写改为post office

senses.en: a card mailed without an envelope, often showing a picture

ex.en: She sent me a postcard from a seaside village.
ex.zh: 她从一个海边村庄给我寄来了一张明信片。

ex.en: Although digital messages are faster, sending a postcard can create a more personal connection between travellers and their families.
ex.zh: 虽然电子信息传递得更快，但寄明信片能让旅行者与家人之间的联系更具人情味。

tip: 寄给某人可说send someone a postcard或用to引出收件人。

senses.en: A round underground vegetable with brown, red, or yellow skin.

ex.en: I baked a potato and filled it with cheese.
ex.zh: 我烤了一个土豆，并在里面填上奶酪。

ex.en: Potato farming provides an important source of food and income for many rural communities worldwide.
ex.zh: 马铃薯种植为世界各地许多农村社区提供了重要的食物和收入来源。

tip: 复数是 potatoes，词尾加 es。

senses.en: Do something repeatedly to improve your skill
Work in a profession such as medicine or law
Regularly follow a belief, custom, or method

ex.en: I practise the violin quietly after dinner each evening.
ex.zh: 我每天晚饭后都会轻声练习小提琴。

ex.en: Language learners should practise speaking regularly rather than rely entirely on memorising vocabulary and grammar rules.
ex.zh: 语言学习者应经常练习口语，而不是完全依赖背诵词汇和语法规则。

col: practise what you preach｜身体力行
tip: 英式动词用practise、名词用practice；美式均用practice。

senses.en: Attractive and pleasant to look at.
To a fairly large degree, especially in informal speech.

ex.en: We found a pretty cottage beside a quiet stream.
ex.zh: 我们在一条安静的小溪边发现了一座漂亮的小屋。

ex.en: Although pretty public gardens attract visitors, cities must also ensure that these spaces remain accessible to residents.
ex.zh: 虽然漂亮的公共花园能吸引游客，但城市也必须确保居民能方便地使用这些空间。

col: a pretty dress｜漂亮的连衣裙
tip: 作副词表示“相当”时偏口语，正式写作可用fairly。

senses.en: The amount of money needed to buy something.
Something unpleasant experienced to achieve or obtain something else.
To decide how much money something will cost.

ex.en: The price of fresh strawberries has fallen this week.
ex.zh: 这周新鲜草莓的价格降了。

ex.en: Rising food prices place considerable pressure on families with limited incomes, particularly in urban areas.
ex.zh: 食品价格上涨给低收入家庭带来很大压力，在城市地区尤其如此。

tip: 价格高低用high或low；物品贵便宜用expensive或cheap。

senses.en: a situation that causes difficulty and needs a solution
a question requiring thought or calculation to answer

ex.en: There's a problem with the kitchen tap: it keeps dripping.
ex.zh: 厨房的水龙头有问题：它一直滴水。

ex.en: Traffic congestion is a growing problem that requires investment in reliable public transport rather than additional roads.
ex.zh: 交通拥堵是日益严重的问题，需要投资建设可靠的公共交通，而不是增建道路。

tip: ……有问题用a problem with；问题的解决办法用to。

senses.en: Having a colour made by mixing red and blue
A colour between red and blue

ex.en: He wore a purple scarf with his grey coat.
ex.zh: 他穿着灰色外套，围了一条紫色围巾。

ex.en: Garden designers often combine purple flowers with yellow varieties to create a striking visual contrast.
ex.zh: 花园设计师常将紫色花卉与黄色品种搭配，形成鲜明的视觉反差。

tip: purple可作形容词或名词；purplish表示“略带紫色的”。

senses.en: to move something into a particular place or position
to express something in a particular way
to cause someone or something to enter a particular state

ex.en: Please put your wet umbrella beside the door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿雨伞放在门旁边。

ex.en: Rising housing costs put considerable pressure on young people who are starting their careers.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本给刚开始职业生涯的年轻人带来很大压力。

col: put something in place｜落实某项安排
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为put；放置义通常需接地点。

senses.en: Something you ask to obtain information or an answer
An issue that needs discussion, consideration, or a decision
To ask someone for information or express doubt about something

ex.en: I raised my hand to ask the teacher a question.
ex.zh: 我举手向老师提了一个问题。

ex.en: Researchers increasingly question whether longer working hours actually improve productivity in modern office environments.
ex.zh: 研究人员越来越质疑，在现代办公环境中，延长工作时间是否真的能提高生产效率。

tip: 动词question可直接接人，表示询问或盘问。

senses.en: moving or acting fast, without much delay
taking only a short time

ex.en: Her quick reaction stopped the glass from falling.
ex.zh: 她反应敏捷，及时接住了差点掉落的玻璃杯。

ex.en: A quick response to reports of water pollution can prevent serious damage to nearby ecosystems.
ex.zh: 对水污染报告作出迅速回应，可以防止附近生态系统遭受严重破坏。

tip: 正式表达中用副词quickly修饰动作。

senses.en: At a fast speed or after only a short time.

ex.en: We quickly packed our bags when the taxi arrived.
ex.zh: 出租车一到，我们就迅速收拾好了行李。

ex.en: Cities must respond quickly to extreme weather events to protect vulnerable residents and maintain essential services.
ex.zh: 城市必须迅速应对极端天气事件，以保护弱势居民并维持基本服务。

tip: quickly是副词，修饰动作；quick是形容词，修饰名词。

senses.en: making little or no noise
having little activity or excitement
a state with little or no noise

ex.en: The house was quiet after the children fell asleep.
ex.zh: 孩子们睡着后，屋子里安静了下来。

ex.en: Quiet study spaces in public libraries are essential for students who cannot concentrate at home.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆内安静的学习空间对无法在家集中注意力的学生至关重要。

tip: quiet是“安静的”，quite是“相当”，注意拼写。

senses.en: a small animal with long ears, soft fur, and strong back legs

ex.en: A white rabbit hopped across the grass towards us.
ex.zh: 一只白兔蹦蹦跳跳地穿过草地，朝我们跑来。

ex.en: Introducing rabbits into new environments can damage native vegetation and disrupt the balance of local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 将兔子引入新环境可能破坏原生植被，扰乱当地生态系统的平衡。

tip: rabbit泛指兔；hare通常指腿耳更长的野兔。

senses.en: a device used to receive and play broadcast sound

senses.zh: 无线电广播；无线电通信
senses.en: broadcasting or communication using electromagnetic waves
to contact someone or send information using radio equipment

ex.en: Dad keeps a small radio on the kitchen shelf.
ex.zh: 爸爸在厨房架子上放着一台小收音机。

ex.en: Radio remains an important source of information in remote communities where reliable internet access is limited.
ex.zh: 在难以稳定上网的偏远社区，广播仍是重要的信息来源。

tip: 听广播常说listen to the radio；在广播中用on the radio。

senses.en: Water that falls from clouds in drops
For water drops to fall from clouds

ex.en: Heavy rain kept us inside for the whole afternoon.
ex.zh: 大雨让我们整个下午都待在屋里。

ex.en: Farmers increasingly depend on stored water because seasonal rain has become less predictable in many regions.
ex.zh: 由于许多地区的季节性降雨越来越难以预测，农民日益依赖储存的水。

col: a chance of rain｜降雨的可能性
tip: rain作名词通常不可数；说下雨用It rains。

senses.en: Having rain, either now or frequently.

ex.en: We stayed indoors and baked bread on that rainy afternoon.
ex.zh: 那个下雨的下午，我们待在室内烤面包。

ex.en: In regions with a long rainy season, reliable drainage systems are essential for protecting homes and roads.
ex.zh: 在雨季漫长的地区，可靠的排水系统对保护房屋和道路至关重要。

tip: rainy是形容词；正在下雨用It is raining。

senses.en: to look at written words and understand their meaning
to say written words aloud
to understand information shown by something

ex.en: I read a few pages before bed every night.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上睡前都会读几页书。

ex.en: Children who read regularly often develop stronger language skills and a broader understanding of the world.
ex.zh: 经常阅读的儿童通常能培养更强的语言能力，对世界也有更广泛的了解。

tip: 原形读/riːd/；过去式及过去分词读/red/。

senses.en: The activity of understanding written words.
A measurement shown by an instrument.
An occasion when someone reads a written work aloud.

ex.en: Reading before bed helps me relax after a busy day.
ex.zh: 忙碌一天后，睡前阅读能让我放松下来。

ex.en: Regular reading exposes students to varied vocabulary and helps them develop stronger critical thinking skills.
ex.zh: 经常阅读能让学生接触丰富的词汇，并帮助他们提高批判性思维能力。

tip: 表示阅读活动通常不可数；表示读数或朗诵会可数。

senses.en: Prepared or available for use or action.
Willing to do something.
About to do something very soon.

ex.en: Dinner is ready, so please bring your plate.
ex.zh: 晚饭好了，请把你的盘子拿来。

ex.en: Schools must ensure that students are ready to meet the demands of a rapidly changing workplace.
ex.zh: 学校必须确保学生做好准备，以应对快速变化的职场需求。

col: ready and willing｜乐意且准备好
tip: ready for后接名词；ready to后接动词原形。

senses.en: existing in fact rather than being imagined
genuine rather than copied or artificial
measured after allowing for changes in prices

ex.en: I thought the bird was plastic, but it was real.
ex.zh: 我以为那只鸟是塑料的，没想到是真的。

ex.en: Although average salaries have increased, rising prices mean that many workers have experienced a fall in real income.
ex.zh: 虽然平均工资上涨了，但物价上涨意味着许多劳动者的实际收入有所下降。

tip: real修饰名词；表示“很、真正地”通常用really。

senses.en: Used to make an adjective, adverb, or statement stronger.
In fact, rather than only apparently or supposedly.
Used in questions to express surprise or doubt.

ex.en: This soup is really hot, so let it cool.
ex.zh: 这汤非常烫，先让它凉一凉吧。

ex.en: Before expanding online education, policymakers should consider whether digital courses really meet the needs of disadvantaged learners.
ex.zh: 在扩大在线教育之前，政策制定者应考虑数字课程是否真正满足弱势学习者的需求。

tip: not really通常表示“不太”，语气比直接说no缓和。

senses.en: Something that explains why something happens or someone acts.
The ability to think logically and make sensible judgments.
To think logically in order to reach a conclusion.

ex.en: The heavy rain was the reason we stayed home.
ex.zh: 大雨是我们待在家里的原因。

ex.en: One reason for rising urban rents is that housing supply has failed to keep pace with population growth.
ex.zh: 城市租金上涨的一个原因是住房供应未能跟上人口增长。

col: reason with someone｜和某人讲道理
tip: 常用reason for加名词，或reason why加从句。

senses.en: having the colour of ripe tomatoes
the colour of ripe tomatoes

ex.en: She wore a red coat to the winter market.
ex.zh: 她穿着一件红色外套去了冬季集市。

ex.en: Designers often use red to draw attention to important warnings on machinery and in public spaces.
ex.zh: 设计师常用红色来突出机器上及公共场所中的重要警示。

tip: in the red表示负债或亏损，不是字面上的红色。

senses.en: To become calm and comfortable, or make someone feel this way.
To make muscles less tight, or become less tight.
To make rules or restrictions less strict.

ex.en: I like to relax with music after dinner.
ex.zh: 我喜欢晚饭后听音乐放松。

ex.en: Regular access to green spaces helps urban residents relax and may improve their overall mental health.
ex.zh: 经常接触绿地有助于城市居民放松，也可能改善他们的整体心理健康。

col: sit back and relax｜靠着坐好并放松
tip: 人感到放松用relaxed；事物令人放松用relaxing。

senses.en: Keep information in your mind or bring it back.
Not forget to do something necessary.
Honour someone or something from the past.

ex.en: I still remember the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
ex.zh: 我至今还记得祖母厨房里的气味。

ex.en: Students often remember new vocabulary more effectively when they use it in meaningful conversations.
ex.zh: 学生在有意义的对话中使用新词汇，往往能更有效地记住它们。

col: remember to do something｜记得去做某事
remember doing something｜记得做过某事
tip: remember to do是记得去做；doing是记得做过。

senses.en: To say or do something again.
Something that happens or is shown again.

ex.en: Could you repeat the address a little more slowly?
ex.zh: 你能把地址再慢一点说一遍吗？

ex.en: Students who repeat new vocabulary aloud regularly may develop greater confidence when speaking a foreign language.
ex.zh: 经常大声重复新词汇的学生，在说外语时可能会更有信心。

col: repeat after someone｜跟着某人复述
tip: repeat已含“再次”之意，通常不必再加again。

senses.en: a period of relaxing without working or being active
to relax or allow someone or something to recover
the people or things that remain

ex.en: Let's have a rest under that shady tree.
ex.zh: 我们在那棵树荫下休息一下吧。

ex.en: Regular periods of rest can help employees maintain concentration and reduce the risk of workplace accidents.
ex.zh: 定期休息有助于员工保持专注，并降低工作场所发生事故的风险。

tip: the rest of后接名词，谓语单复数随所指内容变化。

senses.en: A place where people pay to eat prepared meals.

ex.en: We found a quiet restaurant beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边找到了一家安静的餐馆。

ex.en: Local restaurants can attract tourists by serving traditional dishes made with ingredients from nearby farms.
ex.zh: 当地餐馆可以用附近农场的食材制作传统菜肴，以此吸引游客。

col: book a table at a restaurant｜预订餐馆座位
tip: restaurant指用餐场所；hotel主要指住宿的酒店。

senses.en: A cereal plant whose grains are cooked and eaten.

ex.en: We had rice with steamed fish for dinner.
ex.zh: 我们晚餐吃了米饭和清蒸鱼。

ex.en: Improved irrigation methods can help farmers grow rice while using less water in regions affected by drought.
ex.zh: 改进灌溉方式可帮助受干旱影响地区的农民在减少用水的同时种植水稻。

col: a bowl of rice｜一碗米饭
tip: rice通常不可数；一粒米用a grain of rice。

senses.en: Having a lot of money or valuable possessions.
Containing a large amount or variety of something valuable.
Containing plenty of fat, cream, sugar, or strong flavour.

ex.en: Their rich uncle owns a large house by the sea.
ex.zh: 他们富有的叔叔在海边拥有一栋大房子。

ex.en: Rich countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.
ex.zh: 富裕国家可以通过投资贫困地区的清洁能源项目来支持全球发展。

col: rich in nutrients｜富含营养成分
rich cultural heritage｜丰富的文化遗产
tip: “富含……”用 rich in，不用 rich of。

senses.en: To travel on a bicycle, animal, or vehicle.
A journey on a bicycle, animal, or vehicle.

ex.en: We ride our bikes to the lake every weekend.
ex.zh: 我们每个周末都骑自行车去湖边。

ex.en: Safer cycling routes could encourage more residents to ride bicycles rather than drive for short urban journeys.
ex.zh: 更安全的自行车道可以鼓励更多居民在城市短途出行时骑车，而不是开车。

col: go for a ride｜骑车或乘车兜风
give someone a ride｜让某人搭车
tip: 不规则变化：ride—rode—ridden。

senses.en: Correct, true, or suitable for a particular purpose.
Something you are legally or morally entitled to.
On the side opposite to the left.

ex.en: You picked the right key to open the door.
ex.zh: 你选对了开门的钥匙。

ex.en: Every child has the right to receive an education, regardless of their family's financial circumstances.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都有受教育的权利，无论其家庭经济状况如何。

col: the right to education｜受教育权
make the right decision｜作出正确决定
tip: 表示权利用a right to；表示在右边用on the right。

senses.en: a large natural stream of water flowing towards another water body

ex.en: We watched ducks swimming across the river this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我们看着鸭子游过河面。

ex.en: Protecting river ecosystems requires cooperation between farming communities, local industries, and environmental agencies.
ex.zh: 保护河流生态系统需要农业社区、当地企业和环境机构之间的合作。

tip: 河名通常带the，如the River Nile。

senses.en: a hard surface built for vehicles to travel along
a way of reaching a particular result or situation

ex.en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
ex.zh: 过马路前要向两边看。

ex.en: Investment in road maintenance can improve public safety and reduce transport costs for local businesses.
ex.zh: 投资道路养护能提高公共安全水平，并降低当地企业的运输成本。

col: the road to recovery｜康复之路
tip: on the road常指在旅途中；road to可比喻通往某结果的途径。

senses.en: The capital city of Italy

ex.en: We spent our first afternoon in Rome exploring ancient ruins.
ex.zh: 我们在罗马的第一个下午游览了古代遗址。

ex.en: Cities such as Rome must balance the economic benefits of tourism with the protection of historic sites.
ex.zh: 罗马等城市必须在旅游业的经济收益与历史遗址保护之间取得平衡。

col: a trip to Rome｜罗马之旅
tip: 城市名首字母大写，前面通常不加the。

senses.en: A part of a building separated by walls and doors.
Available space or opportunity for something.

ex.en: My room has a desk beside the window.
ex.zh: 我的房间里，窗边有一张书桌。

ex.en: Although public transport has improved significantly, there is still room for further investment in rural services.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通已显著改善，农村交通服务仍有进一步投资的空间。

tip: 指房间时可数；指空间或余地时不可数。

senses.en: A straight tool for measuring lengths or drawing straight lines.
A person who governs a country or territory.

ex.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line here.
ex.zh: 用尺子在这里画一条直线。

ex.en: The decisions of ancient rulers often influenced trade, architecture, and the daily lives of ordinary people.
ex.zh: 古代统治者的决策往往影响贸易、建筑以及普通人的日常生活。

col: measure with a ruler｜用尺子测量
tip: a ruler可指一把尺子或一位统治者，需看语境。

senses.en: move quickly on foot, lifting both feet between steps
manage a business, organisation, or activity
operate, or make a machine or program operate

ex.en: We ran through the park before breakfast today.
ex.zh: 今天早饭前，我们跑步穿过了公园。

ex.en: Local councils often run training programmes to help unemployed residents develop skills needed by employers.
ex.zh: 地方议会经常开办培训项目，帮助失业居民培养雇主所需的技能。

tip: 过去式ran，过去分词run；现在分词running。

senses.en: Relating to Russia, its people, or its language.
A person from Russia.
The main language spoken in Russia.

ex.en: We cooked Russian dumplings for dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我们做了俄式饺子当晚餐。

ex.en: Studying Russian literature can help students explore how historical events influence cultural identity and artistic expression.
ex.zh: 学习俄罗斯文学可以帮助学生探究历史事件如何影响文化认同和艺术表达。

tip: 首字母须大写；指俄语时通常不加冠词。

senses.en: a cold dish of vegetables or other mixed ingredients

ex.en: I added cucumber and tomatoes to the salad.
ex.zh: 我往沙拉里加了黄瓜和番茄。

ex.en: Offering fresh salad in school cafeterias can encourage children to eat a wider variety of vegetables.
ex.zh: 学校食堂供应新鲜沙拉，有助于鼓励儿童摄入更多种类的蔬菜。

tip: 可指一份沙拉，也可不可数地指沙拉这种食物。

senses.en: a white substance used to flavour or preserve food
to add salt to food or preserve it with salt

ex.en: Please pass the salt before the soup gets cold.
ex.zh: 趁汤还没凉，请把盐递过来。

ex.en: Reducing salt intake is an effective way to lower the risk of high blood pressure.
ex.zh: 减少盐的摄入量是降低高血压风险的有效方法。

col: a pinch of salt｜一小撮盐
tip: 食盐通常不可数；“一小撮盐”用a pinch of salt。

senses.en: Exactly alike, or referring to one particular thing rather than another.
The very thing already mentioned, or something exactly like it.

ex.en: We take the same bus to school every morning.
ex.zh: 我们每天早上乘同一班公交车上学。

ex.en: Students from different backgrounds should have the same opportunities to access high-quality education and develop their talents.
ex.zh: 不同背景的学生应享有同样的机会，接受优质教育并发展自己的才能。

tip: 通常用the same；比较时用the same as。

senses.en: Two slices of bread with a filling between them.
To place or squeeze something between two other things.

ex.en: I packed a cheese sandwich and an apple for lunch.
ex.zh: 我带了一个奶酪三明治和一个苹果当午餐。

ex.en: School cafeterias can promote healthier eating by offering sandwiches made with wholegrain bread and fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 学校食堂可以提供用全麦面包和新鲜蔬菜制作的三明治，促进更健康的饮食。

tip: 动词常用被动结构be sandwiched between。

senses.en: the day after Friday and before Sunday

ex.en: We usually buy fresh vegetables at the market on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们通常星期六去市场买新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Opening public libraries on Saturday allows more working parents to participate in educational activities with their children.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆在星期六开放，让更多上班的家长能与孩子一起参加教育活动。

tip: 首字母大写；on Saturday，但this Saturday前不用on。

senses.en: To express something using words.
To give information in writing or through other evidence.
The opportunity to influence a decision.

ex.en: Please say your name again so I can remember it.
ex.zh: 请再说一遍你的名字，好让我记住。

ex.en: Residents should have a say in planning decisions that directly affect their neighbourhoods and daily lives.
ex.zh: 居民应当对直接影响其社区和日常生活的规划决策拥有发言权。

col: say something to someone｜对某人说某事
have a say in｜对……有发言权
tip: 说某事用say something；告诉某人用tell someone。

senses.en: A place where children learn, or the time spent learning there.
A group sharing particular ideas, methods, or styles.
A group of fish swimming together.

ex.en: We walk to school together along the river.
ex.zh: 我们一起沿着河边步行上学。

ex.en: Every school should provide opportunities for students to develop practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
ex.zh: 每所学校都应提供机会，让学生在学习学科知识的同时培养实践技能。

tip: go to school指上学；go to the school指去校址。

senses.en: Study of the natural world through observation and experiments
A particular field of study using scientific methods

ex.en: We grew tiny crystals in our science class today.
ex.zh: 今天的科学课上，我们培育了微小的晶体。

ex.en: Investment in science can help countries develop cleaner energy sources and improve public health.
ex.zh: 科学投入能帮助各国开发更清洁的能源，并改善公共健康。

tip: 泛指科学通常不可数；指具体学科可用a science。

senses.en: the large area of salt water covering much of Earth
a large mass of similar things seen together

ex.en: The children watched small boats sailing across the sea.
ex.zh: 孩子们看着小船在海上航行。

ex.en: Plastic waste entering the sea threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human food supplies.
ex.zh: 进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生生物，并可能最终影响人类的食物供应。

col: a sea of faces｜人头攒动
tip: at sea指在海上；by the sea指在海边。

senses.en: A place or object for someone to sit on.
To provide a sitting place or have room for seated people.
A position as a member of an elected body.

ex.en: She saved me a seat near the front.
ex.zh: 她在靠前的位置给我留了一个座位。

ex.en: Providing more seats on public transport would make daily travel easier for older passengers and families.
ex.zh: 在公共交通工具上增加座位，会让老年乘客和家庭的日常出行更方便。

tip: sit是不及物动词；seat常接人，be seated表就座。

senses.en: Coming immediately after the first in an order.
A unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute.
To formally support a proposal made by someone else.

ex.en: This is my second cup of tea today.
ex.zh: 这是我今天喝的第二杯茶。

ex.en: Learning a second language can broaden career opportunities and help students understand perspectives from other cultures.
ex.zh: 学习第二语言可以拓宽职业机会，并帮助学生理解其他文化的观点。

tip: the second指第二个；a second可指又一个。

senses.en: to notice something using your eyes
to understand something
to meet or visit someone

ex.en: I can see a rainbow above the trees.
ex.zh: 我能看见树梢上方有一道彩虹。

ex.en: When students see how science applies to everyday life, they often become more interested in learning.
ex.zh: 当学生理解科学如何应用于日常生活时，他们往往会对学习更感兴趣。

col: see someone's point｜理解某人的意思
tip: 过去式saw，过去分词seen；强调看见而非观看。

senses.en: to give something to someone in exchange for money
to be bought in a particular quantity or way
to persuade someone to accept an idea or proposal

ex.en: They sell fresh bread at the market every Saturday.
ex.zh: 他们每周六都在市场卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Small businesses increasingly sell their products online to reach customers beyond their local communities.
ex.zh: 小企业越来越多地在线销售产品，以吸引本地社区以外的顾客。

col: sell something to someone｜把某物卖给某人
sell an idea｜推销一个想法
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sold；sell well常用主动形式。

senses.en: To make something go or be delivered to another place.
To arrange for someone to go somewhere.

ex.en: Please send me a photo of your new puppy.
ex.zh: 请发一张你家新养的小狗的照片给我。

ex.en: Governments should send medical teams to isolated communities that lack access to basic healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应向缺乏基本医疗服务的偏远社区派遣医疗队。

col: send someone to do something｜派某人去做某事
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sent；可用send sth to sb。

senses.en: a group of words expressing a complete statement, question, or command
a punishment officially given by a court
to officially give someone a punishment in court

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to write one sentence about autumn.
ex.zh: 老师让我们写一个关于秋天的句子。

ex.en: Learning to vary sentence length can help students express complex ideas more clearly in academic essays.
ex.zh: 学会变化句子长度，可以帮助学生在学术文章中更清晰地表达复杂观点。

col: sentence someone to｜判处某人……刑罚
tip: 判某人某种刑罚用sentence sb to sth。

senses.en: The month after August and before October.

ex.en: Our evening photography course starts in September this year.
ex.zh: 我们今年的摄影夜课九月开课。

ex.en: In many countries, the academic year begins in September, creating seasonal demand for student accommodation near universities.
ex.zh: 许多国家的学年在九月开始，使大学附近的学生住宿出现季节性需求。

tip: 月份首字母大写；用 in September，但 next September 前不加 in。

senses.en: The number after sixteen and before eighteen.

ex.en: My sister is seventeen and loves playing volleyball.
ex.zh: 我妹妹十七岁，喜欢打排球。

ex.en: The survey found that seventeen students preferred practical training to traditional classroom instruction.
ex.zh: 调查发现，十七名学生更喜欢实践培训，而非传统课堂教学。

tip: 注意与seventy（七十）区分，词尾读清。

senses.en: a farm animal kept for its wool, meat or milk

ex.en: Several sheep were resting under a tree near the farm.
ex.zh: 几只绵羊正在农场附近的一棵树下休息。

ex.en: Keeping too many sheep on fragile grasslands can damage vegetation and increase the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 在脆弱的草地上饲养过多绵羊会破坏植被，增加水土流失的风险。

col: a flock of sheep｜一群绵羊
tip: sheep单复数同形；山羊是goat。

senses.en: an upper-body garment, usually with sleeves, a collar, and front buttons

ex.en: He ironed his blue shirt before the interview.
ex.zh: 他在面试前熨好了自己的蓝衬衫。

ex.en: Some employers require staff to wear a formal shirt, while others allow more casual clothing.
ex.zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式衬衫，另一些则允许更休闲的着装。

col: button up a shirt｜扣好衬衫扣子
tip: shirt通常指衬衫；T-shirt才是T恤。

senses.en: A covering for the foot, usually with a firm sole.

ex.en: There was a small stone inside my shoe.
ex.zh: 我的鞋里有一颗小石子。

ex.en: Comfortable shoes are essential for workers who spend most of their working day standing.
ex.zh: 对于工作时大部分时间都站着的员工来说，舒适的鞋子至关重要。

tip: 一双鞋用a pair of shoes，shoe为可数名词。

senses.en: A place where people buy goods or services.
To visit stores or websites to look for and buy things.

ex.en: The little shop near our house sells fresh bread.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的小店卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Independent shops can strengthen local economies by creating jobs and keeping spending within the community.
ex.zh: 独立商店可以通过创造就业并让消费留在社区内，促进地方经济。

tip: 买某类商品用shop for；泛指去购物用go shopping。

senses.en: The activity of looking for and buying things.
The things you have bought during a shopping trip.

ex.en: We usually do our shopping early on Saturday mornings.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期六一早去购物。

ex.en: The growth of online shopping has changed consumer habits and increased demand for home delivery services.
ex.zh: 网上购物的发展改变了消费者习惯，也增加了对送货上门服务的需求。

tip: shopping作名词不可数；“去购物”用go shopping。

senses.en: Having little length, height, or duration.
Not having as much of something as is needed.
Before reaching a target, or with a sudden stop.

ex.en: We took a short walk before dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚饭前，我们散了一小会儿步。

ex.en: Short training courses can help unemployed adults acquire practical skills without committing to several years of study.
ex.zh: 短期培训课程能帮助失业成年人获得实用技能，而不必投入数年时间学习。

tip: short of表示缺少；shortly通常意为“不久”。

senses.en: To let someone see something or demonstrate how something works.
To provide information or evidence that something is true.
A performance, programme, or public display intended for an audience.

ex.en: Please show me how to fold this paper bird.
ex.zh: 请教我怎么折这只纸鸟。

ex.en: Recent studies show that access to green spaces can improve mental wellbeing in urban populations.
ex.zh: 近期研究表明，能够使用绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: show someone how to｜教某人如何
tip: 过去式showed，过去分词通常用shown。

senses.en: Washing under falling water, or the equipment used for this
A short period of rain
Wash your body under water falling from a shower

ex.en: I always take a warm shower after cycling home.
ex.zh: 我骑车回家后总会洗个温水澡。

ex.en: Taking shorter showers is a simple way for households to reduce both water consumption and energy use.
ex.zh: 缩短淋浴时间是家庭减少用水和能源消耗的一种简单方法。

tip: 洗淋浴可用take或have a shower；阵雨也叫shower。

senses.en: An edge or surface of something, or the space beside it.
One aspect of something or one group in a disagreement.
To support one person or group in a disagreement.

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots by the side door.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在侧门旁。

ex.en: Public debates should consider both sides of an issue before any major policy decision is made.
ex.zh: 在作出任何重大政策决定之前，公共讨论都应考虑问题的正反两面。

col: the other side of the argument｜争论的另一面
tip: side with表示支持某方；side by side表示并排。

senses.en: To make musical sounds with your voice.
For a bird to make pleasant musical sounds.

ex.en: We sing our favourite songs while washing the dishes.
ex.zh: 我们一边洗碗，一边唱自己最喜欢的歌。

ex.en: Children who sing together regularly may develop greater confidence and stronger relationships with their classmates.
ex.zh: 经常一起唱歌的孩子可能会变得更加自信，与同学的关系也更加紧密。

col: sing in a choir｜在合唱团唱歌
tip: 不规则变化：sing—sang—sung。

senses.en: A person who sings, especially as a job.

ex.en: The singer smiled as the audience began to clap.
ex.zh: 观众开始鼓掌时，歌手露出了笑容。

ex.en: Local festivals provide young singers with valuable opportunities to perform publicly and develop confidence in their abilities.
ex.zh: 当地节庆为年轻歌手提供了宝贵的公开演出机会，帮助他们建立对自身能力的信心。

tip: sing 的过去式、过去分词分别是 sang、sung。
